content: No, the capital of Australia is not Sydney. The capital of Australia is Canberra. Sydney is the largest city in Australia and the capital of the state of New South Wales, but Canberra was specifically designed and built to serve as the national capital. It is located in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT).
